Ensure the project timeline schedule. Support the Sales Team for the other external site survey. 8. Conduct Grid Impact and Interconnection Studies for new projects and assess their impact on the existing power network. Design and evaluate substation layouts (AIS/GIS), single line diagrams, equipment sizing, and protection schemes. Evaluate grid integration requirements for renewable energy projects (solar, wind, hybrid). Participate in technical reviews, risk assessments, and design optimization discussions.
